summary: The Generation Essentials Group (TGE), a subsidiary of AMTD Digital Inc., filed a Form 6-K announcing a share repurchase program of up to US$10 million of its ordinary shares. TGE expects to fund repurchases from existing cash balance, with timing subject to Rule 10b-18/10b5-1. Concurrently, controlling shareholder AMTD Digital Inc., directors, and management voluntarily agreed to a two-year lock-up. The board believes shares are drastically undervalued given a 17.7% increase in total asset value to ~US$1.7 billion. No premium, price, or advisor named. What to watch: open-market execution risk and potential for increased buyback size.
